name: Azure Data Factory Workspace
description: Azure Data Factory workspace component (v0.10.78 flagship-shape refactor) — one Dagster asset per ADF pipeline, trigger, and (UNTESTED) linked_service / dataset / data_flow / integration_runtime. Full Fivetran-shape workspace: canonical `workspace:` block (AzureDataFactoryResource), `translation:` callable per-asset customization hook, `@public get_asset_spec(props)` subclass override, `AzureDataFactoryObjectProps` + `AzureDataFactoryComponentTranslator`. StateBackedComponent — discovery cached to disk; auto-refreshes on first `dg dev` OR run `dg utils refresh-defs-state` explicitly. Aligns with SnowflakeWorkspaceComponent / QlikReplicateWorkspaceComponent / FivetranAccountComponent.

inputs.description: Discovery hits ADF Management API; no upstream Dagster inputs.

outputs.description: One @multi_asset per ADF pipeline, external assets per trigger / linked_service / dataset / data_flow / integration_runtime, plus optional polling sensor for pipeline-run observation.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.description: Azure Data Factory connection as an AzureDataFactoryResource: `{subscription_id, resource_group_name, factory_name, tenant_id_env_var?, client_id_env_var?, client_secret_env_var?}`. Falls back to DefaultAzureCredential when SP env vars aren't set. Secrets typically arrive via `{{ env.XXX }}` Jinja templating. Mirrors the `workspace:` shape used by dagster-fivetran / dagster-databricks / SnowflakeWorkspaceComponent.

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Python callable path resolved via Dagster's TranslationFn — customizes per-asset AssetSpec (key rename, extra tags/metadata, group override). Signature: `def fn(props: AzureDataFactoryObjectProps) -> AssetSpec`. Same convention as dagster-fivetran / dagster-snowflake.

import_pipelines.label: Import Pipelines
import_pipelines.description: Import ADF pipelines as materializable multi_assets (default true).

import_triggers.label: Import Triggers
import_triggers.description: Import ADF triggers as observable external assets.

import_linked_services.label: Import Linked Services (UNTESTED)
import_linked_services.description: **UNTESTED.** Import ADF linked services (data source / sink connections) as external Dagster assets. Read-only surface — no runtime action. Validate against your factory before use.

import_datasets.label: Import Datasets (UNTESTED)
import_datasets.description: **UNTESTED.** Import ADF datasets (schemas over linked services) as external Dagster assets. Read-only surface. Validate before use.

import_data_flows.label: Import Data Flows (UNTESTED)
import_data_flows.description: **UNTESTED.** Import ADF Mapping Data Flows (visual transformations) as external Dagster assets. Read-only surface. Validate before use.

import_integration_runtimes.label: Import Integration Runtimes (UNTESTED)
import_integration_runtimes.description: **UNTESTED.** Import ADF Integration Runtimes (SSIS / Azure IR / Self-hosted IR) as external Dagster assets. Read-only surface. Validate before use.

filter_by_name_pattern.label: Filter By Name Pattern
filter_by_name_pattern.description: Regex — only entities whose names match are imported. Applied to every kind.

exclude_name_pattern.label: Exclude Name Pattern
exclude_name_pattern.description: Regex — entities whose names match are excluded. Applied after `filter_by_name_pattern`.

filter_by_tags.label: Filter By Tags
filter_by_tags.description: Comma-separated tag keys that entities must carry.

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: Emit a polling sensor that observes ADF pipeline-run status. Same convention as FivetranAccountComponent / SnowflakeWorkspaceComponent's `polling_sensor`. Previously named `generate_sensor` — renamed in v0.10.78.

extra_kinds.label: Extra Kinds
extra_kinds.description: Additional `dagster/kind/*` tags applied to every asset.

asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix
asset_key_prefix.description: Optional key prefix — every asset key gets `[<prefix>..., adf_<kind>_<name>]`.

assets_by_pipeline_name.label: Assets By Pipeline Name
assets_by_pipeline_name.description: Legacy hook: override or expand AssetSpecs for specific ADF pipelines. Keys are ADF pipeline names; values are single spec-override dicts or lists. For finer-grained per-asset customization, prefer the `translation:` callable.

pipeline_parameters.label: Pipeline Parameters
pipeline_parameters.description: Parameters dict passed to every ADF pipeline run (key → value).

partition_parameter_name.label: Partition Parameter Name
partition_parameter_name.description: When the asset is partitioned, auto-pass the partition_key as this ADF pipeline parameter.

defs_state.label: Defs State
defs_state.description: State backend for cached workspace discovery. Local filesystem by default; override per-deploy for Dagster Cloud.
